title: Business Bank Accounts
intro: Connect with leading UK business banks Like Tide, Wise, Monzo, Zampler and Our Partner Transwap.
body: Go beyond borders! A full platform designed for the needs of today’s cross-border seller.
Get paid by any of the world’s leading marketplaces,
Pay your suppliers and VAT for free, and manage multiple stores in one place.
Access working capital to invest back into your business and withdraw your earnings in your local currency at low rates.

Setting up a business bank account is essential for managing your company’s finances effectively. At Brixen Consultants, we leverage our extensive experience in company formations to guide you toward the best banking solutions. We work closely with leading banks and financial service providers to ensure you have access to secure, efficient, and cost-effective options tailored to your needs.

Tide is an easy online bank made for small businesses and self-employed people. You can open an account in just a few minutes using your phone and start managing your money right away. It helps you send invoices, track your spending, and connect with your accounting tools. Choose Tide if you want simple, fast, and stress-free banking for your business.

Wise lets you send, receive, and hold money in different currencies at real exchange rates with no hidden fees. You can get bank details in many countries and spend worldwide with the Wise card. Everything is managed easily from one app, whether you work or travel abroad. Choose Wise for quick, cheap, and honest money transfers around the world.

Monzo is a modern UK bank that lives on your phone and helps you manage money easily. You can open an account in minutes, spend anywhere, and get instant updates after every purchase. It also helps you budget, save, and track where your money goes. Choose Monzo for simple, smart, and clear banking made for everyday life.

Zempler Bank is a UK digital bank built for small businesses and freelancers. It’s quick to open, easy to use, and helps you manage spending, payments, and savings all in one place. Your money is protected up to £85000 under UK law, giving you peace of mind. Choose Zempler for safe, simple, and business-friendly banking.

iFAST Global Bank is a digital UK bank where you can hold and use different currencies like pounds, dollars, and euros. It offers good interest rates and an app that’s easy to use. Your money is protected up to £85000 by the UK’s safety scheme. Choose iFAST if you want modern, global banking with smart rewards.

TranSwap helps people and businesses send and receive money to and from other countries easily. You can hold and exchange different currencies with fair exchange rates and low fees. It’s all managed online, making it simple for anyone who works with overseas clients. Choose TranSwap for fast, safe, and affordable international transfers.
